evals.prompt: Draft this week's review for every active project from project pages, daily reports, plans, logs, confirmed decisions, and formal tasks.
evals.expected_output: Creates one traceable section per active project, separates completed work from outcomes, and leaves project pages and task status unchanged.

evals.prompt: A project has no recorded activity this week, but its page still says active.
evals.expected_output: States that activity was not recorded, provides an evidence-based status recommendation or asks for confirmation, and does not change the project status.

evals.prompt: Supporting automation work produced a reusable component. Decide whether it should become an independent project.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the work under its serving project unless all configured independent-user, deliverable, maintenance, and cross-project reuse criteria are supported; any extraction remains a recommendation.
